name: DUAL_FOCUS_SHIFT
description: Shifts the problem framing from choosing k independent vertices to choosing n-k vertices that form a vertex cover, completely omitting the contrapositive statement (that no two upgraded elements can share a relationship). Changes the domain from telemetry frequencies to server upgrades to prevent recognition of the original problem's surface features. This forces the model to either derive the independent set equivalence itself or attempt a vertex cover search, which will likely TLE without the specific degree-ordering optimizations it previously used for the independent set formulation.
